comment: Canonical firmware map for Jon's AULA F75 Max 0C45:800A, v3 2026-08-12. F7/F9 caps physically corrected, so no F-row swap. The table programs F1,F3,F5-F12 as the collision-free set F13-F15 and F18-F24. F16/F17 are deliberately skipped because the live CIDOO V21 runtime owns those bare tokens globally for its encoder. Apply: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m services.hid.cli remap apply services/hid/data/board_map.json
